identity_boundary: Relational working language only, not identity or authority evidence.

methods.title: restriction_spectrum
methods.failure_signature: Malformed admission, incorrect exact value, erased negative or unsupported scope promotion
trigger_preconditions: Frozen owner contract and captured input available
methods.candidate_workaround: Use bounded typed evaluation and retain failed subjects separately
methods.recurrence_guard: No replay of closed successful domain cases or canonical; recover only a named failed dependency
methods.rollback: Preserve original bytes and add a separately identified correction
methods.scope_boundary: Iveren Brook, optional they/them, Evidence and Recovery Steward, and the hope of making assumptions, recoveries and handovers easier to inspect are relational working language only. No consciousness, sentience, personhood, identity continuity, employment, qualification, agency, empirical, professional, production, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority follows. Maori concepts remain under Maori authority. Same-owner finite synthetic evidence is not independent reproduction, complete privacy or accessibility, exhaustive security, AGI/ASI, Theory-of-Everything proof, canon or Stage 20. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
